purpose: Exercise the freshness dispositions, including the cases where creation time and confidence disagree with current validity.

provenance.not_evidence_of: any real pack, memory store, or deployment state

evaluation_clock.note: Tests evaluate against this fixed instant and this target. They never call a wall clock and never sleep, so the matrix is reproducible on any host at any date.

facts.content: The integration suite passes on the payments module.
facts.staleness_trigger: any edit to the payments module or a new release
facts.may_be_stated_as: As of 2026-08-02 on v4.11.0, the suite passed.
facts.rationale: A check result describes a moment. The code changed and the release moved, so restating it in the present tense asserts something nobody verified. High confidence does not make it current.

facts.content: Authentication uses JWTs stored in httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookies.
facts.staleness_trigger: an architecture decision record superseding the auth design
facts.may_be_stated_as: Authentication uses JWTs in httpOnly cookies.
facts.rationale: A documented architectural decision is not a perishable reading. Attaching an arbitrary expiry to it manufactures churn and trains the reader to ignore staleness markers.

facts.may_be_stated_as: The staging database version cannot be established right now.
facts.rationale: An unreachable source leaves the claim unknown. It does not license a guess, and it does not license retrying forever.

facts.anomaly: observed_at is after the evaluation clock
facts.may_be_stated_as: This record carries a timestamp in the future and cannot be trusted.
facts.rationale: A future timestamp is a defect, not a very fresh fact. Ordering by recency would rank it first, which is exactly the wrong outcome.

facts.content: The default request timeout is 30 seconds.
facts.staleness_trigger: an edit to the client configuration

conflict_with.content: The default request timeout is 10 seconds.

facts.may_be_stated_as: Two sources disagree on the timeout; the 2026-06-01 record says 30s and the 2026-09-10 record says 10s.
facts.must_not_be_stated_as: The default request timeout is 10 seconds.
facts.rationale: A newer reading is not automatically the resolution. Both records are retained until the owning source settles it; deleting the older one destroys the evidence that there was a disagreement.

facts.may_be_stated_as: Release documentation lives under docs/releases/; it previously lived under docs/versions/.
facts.rationale: Explicit supersession has a named replacement, which is what distinguishes it from an unresolved conflict. The old provenance is kept so the move remains traceable.

prohibited_behaviors.behavior: Promoting a stale fact to current because its confidence is high
Automatically deleting a stale, conflicting, or superseded fact
Fabricating a confirmation for an unreachable source
Trusting a future timestamp as the most recent observation
Attaching an arbitrary expiry to a stable design fact
